'''Sulabha Kashinath Kulkarni''' (born 1 June 1949) is an Indian physicist, whose research spans the areas of [[Nanotechnology]], [[Materials Science]], and [[Surface Science]]. She is currently a visiting faculty member at [[IISER Pune|Indian Institute of Science Education and Research]], Pune, India.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.iiserpune.ac.in/people/faculty-details/33 |title=Bio|website=www.iiserpune.ac.in}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Born in 1949, Kulkarni was educated in Pune and earned her [[Bachelor of Science]] (1969), [[Master of Science]] (1971), and [[Doctor of Philosophy]] (1976) in Physics from the [[University of Pune]]. From 1976 to 1977, she conducted her post-doctoral research on gas/solid interactions using surface science techniques in the Physics Department (E20) at the [[Technical University of Munich]], Germany.<ref name="insaindia.org">{{cite web |url=http://insaindia.org/detail.php?id=P11-1548 |title=INSA |access-date=2013-09-03 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140404104534/http://insaindia.org/detail.php?id=P11-1548 |archive-date=2014-04-04 }}</ref>

== Work and career ==
Kulkarni joined as a faculty member in the Department of Physics at the [[University of Pune]] upon her return to India. She continued to research and teach for 32 years, also introducing a course on Nanotechnology at the post-graduate level. In March 2009, she joined the [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research]] (IISER) in Pune and continued as a [[University Grants Commission (India)|UGC]] scientist. From 2010 to 2011, she served as Pro Vice Chancellor at the [[Banasthali Vidyapith|Banasthali University]], Rajasthan. She returned to IISER Pune as UGC Professor and is currently a Visiting Faculty at IISER Pune.<ref name=IASFellowProfile>{{cite web|title=Fellow Profile – Kulkarni, Prof. Sulabha Kashinath|url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Kulkarni,_Prof._Sulabha_Kashinath|website=Indian Academy of Sciences|publisher=[[Indian Academy of Sciences]]|accessdate=23 January 2016|location=Bangalore}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
* Associate editor, ''Journal of Nanophotonics'' (2011–)<ref>spie.org/x90356.xml</ref>
* Fellow (FNA), Indian National Science Academy (New Delhi) (2011–)<ref name="insaindia.org"/>
* Bharatiya Stree Shakti "Women and Technological Innovation National Award" (2007)<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bharatiyastreeshakti.org/awards.html |title=Awards - Bharatiya Stree Shakti |website=www.bharatiyastreeshakti.org |access-date=15 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141019013741/http://www.bharatiyastreeshakti.org/awards.html |archive-date=19 October 2014 |url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Associate editor, International Journal of Nanoscience & Nanotechnology (2006–)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ijnnonline.net/journal/editorial.board|title=International Journal of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology - Editorial Board|website=www.ijnnonline.net}}</ref>
* Fellow (FASc), Indian Academy of Science (Bangalore) (2004–)<ref name=IASFellowProfile/>
* Fellow (FNASc), National Academy of Sciences, India (Allahabad), (2003–)<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=K |title=The National Academy of Sciences, India - Fellows |access-date=2016-10-20 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160315081652/http://nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=K |archive-date=2016-03-15 }}</ref>
* Elected President, IPA Pune Chapter (1996–1998)<ref>{{cite web |url=http://physics.unipune.ernet.in/~ipa/list.htm |title=1 |website=physics.unipune.ernet.in |access-date=15 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061212012048/http://physics.unipune.ernet.in/~ipa/list.htm |archive-date=12 December 2006 |url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Fellow, Maharashtra Academy of Sciences (1995–)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mahascience.org/files/Fellowship/files/academyMembers.htm#s|title=Maharashtra academy of sciences|website=mahascience.org}}</ref>
